diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: The claimer ran successfully (1 claim, all 3 cards now on cooldown); "failure reason: unknown" is a false alarm — `_diagnosis_prompt()` in daemon.py always emits a "Most recent failure reason" line using `fail_detail or reason or "unknown"`, but for a successful run both fields are `None`, so the fallback fires and makes a healthy cycle look like an unclassified crash.
